subagent_note: None dispatched: the round refutes a claim made one round earlier and records the retraction in both the positioning document and the register.

design.data: GDSC, grouped splits by combination, 40 splits
design.variants: ridge x {tissue, pathway} x lambda {0.1,1,5,20,50,200} plus hierarchical x lambda_inter {2,5,20,50,200}

refutation: across 17 variants on identical data and splits, changes in global rho and precision@10 correlate POSITIVELY; better global ordering comes with a better tail

what_the_three_were.C19: two properties of one model (bulk vs tail), a different construct
what_the_three_were.C28: a decision-rule comparison, not a model-quality comparison
what_the_three_were.C34: a genuine but tiny inversion (+0.006 rho, -0.007 p10) that shrinks as lambda_inter grows

retraction.claim: R45 candidate contribution #1: systematic inversion between global metrics and the decision tail

methodological_lesson: seeing the same pattern in a few comparisons is not evidence of a systematic law; the check is to ask what the sign of the cross-variant relationship would be if the law held

register_updates.C35: new and refuted: no systematic inversion
